documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported record-breaking quarterly financial results for Q1 FY 2027, driven by strong growth across exports, electric vehicles, and premium motorcycles despite facing raw material inflation, currency movements, and supply chain disruptions. Management highlighted that capacity constraints impacted full demand fulfillment, prompting a planned capacity expansion from 7 million to 9 million units per annum. The company also executed extensive portfolio makeovers in domestic motorcycles and maintained robust free cash flows and surplus cash reserves. Bajaj Auto management reported a defining year for FY26 with record performance across all business units, achieving revenues exceeding INR58,000 crores and EBITDA surpassing INR12,000 crores. Q4 FY26 was a standout quarter driven by strong growth in exports, domestic motorcycles, probiking, and electric vehicles, though management flagged near-term demand softening and significant commodity inflation in Q1 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management estimates the motorcycle category growth to slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects export business to reach 2,20,000 units per month this quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.
guidance.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

guidance.claim: Management expects the export growth tempo to continue in the coming months.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months.

guidance.claim: The company expects the export business to deliver its highest-ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: Management expects 3-wheeler industry growth rates to sustain in the immediate future.
guidance.quote: Again, we expect these growth rates to sustain in the immediate future as driver adoption is responding to the healthy improvements in earnings and paybacks, both for ICE and electric.

guidance.claim: The company expects to grow its leadership position quite decisively in the e-auto segment in coming quarters.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow our leadership position quite decisively in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across both domestic and international markets is very positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, price hikes, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters now and reporting another all-time high performance, driven by strong growth in almost each and every country.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and continued to grow at over 60% in April.
demand_outlook.quote: The E-segment, scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and has continued to grow at an even higher rate of 60% plus in April, far outpacing the growth of ICE scooters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% in the quarter while Bajaj sales grew at 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Post GST rationalization, Q3 industry growth for motorcycles has been about 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, slipping to minus 3% in Q2. But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Quality of growth is supported by the 125cc plus segment growing faster and the 150cc plus segment growing even faster.
demand_outlook.quote: Equally important is the quality of growth with the 125cc plus segment growing at a faster rate and within that, the 150cc plus segment growing even faster.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is undertaking a capacity expansion of nearly 25% from 7 million units per annum to 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Brazil manufacturing capacity has increased to 60,000 units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came close to the 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came in close to 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities and the subsidiary is now delivering a healthy bottom line performance too.

capex_expansion.claim: The footprint of Riki is being expanded to 50 cities in North and East India.
capex_expansion.quote: Steadily, the footprint of Riki is being expanded to now 50 cities in North and East India.

capex_expansion.claim: Joint KTM-Triumph showrooms are planned to expand to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

capex_expansion.claim: The company strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during the 9-month period into Netherlands subsidiary BAIHBV and BACL.
capex_expansion.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation intensified during the quarter, taking the overall inflationary impact to about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Calibrated pricing actions implemented through April and June enabled the company to offset nearly half of the commodity inflation.
margins_costs.quote: And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: Chetak moved from being EBITDA neutral to EBITDA positive.
margins_costs.quote: So, we now have the contribution of an EBITDA positive on Chetak in addition to the growing scale of the electric three-wheeler that is leading to an overall portfolio margin of double digit.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 EBITDA margins came in at 20.8%, sustaining above the 20% threshold.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at INR3,323 crores and the margins at 20.8% sustained despite challenges in the operating environment.

margins_costs.claim: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise of about 3% to 5% driven by the metal complex.
margins_costs.quote: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise during the quarter of about 3% to 5%, driven by the metal complex.

margins_costs.claim: Noble metals saw sharp moves firming up in the range of 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: Within this, noble metals, rhodium, palladium and platinum saw particularly sharp moves, firming up in the range of between 20 - 25%, accompanied by broader inflation across copper, aluminium and lead as well.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: The net price versus cost inflation hit was nearly 50 basis points on the margin due to deferred pricing actions.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: Noble metals saw sharp increases, while aluminium, copper, nickel, and lead continued to harden, partly offset by ABS and steel softening.
margins_costs.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden. This was partly offset by some softening in ABS and steel.

margins_costs.claim: The company recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards past service cost arising from the new labour code.
margins_costs.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

orders_capacity.claim: Supply chain disruptions and other issues impaired vehicle availabilities by about 10% to 15%.
orders_capacity.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

orders_capacity.claim: Demand for Chetak continued to remain ahead of the company's ability to supply.
orders_capacity.quote: Demand, however, continued to remain ahead of our ability to supply.

orders_capacity.claim: Export business crossed the 6,00,000 units mark for the second consecutive quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports business unit, starting off with that, the BU crossed the 6,00,000 units mark for the second consecutive quarter, clocking 25% growth year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volumes reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units in Q4, growing 24% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volumes reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units, growing 24% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak crossed the 1 lakh retail mark for the very first time in a single quarter in Q4.
orders_capacity.quote: In Chetak, the electric scooter business, in quarter 4, Chetak crossed the 1 lakh retail mark for the very first time in a single quarter, the highest ever quarterly retails for the brand.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volumes crossed the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains a 70% plus market share in the ICE 3-wheeler segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during the quarter, representing about 80% of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet stood in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a payout of 100% of profits made last year, split as a final dividend of INR150 per share and a tender buyback at INR12,000 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores, a reflection of the very robust cash conversion on profit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: In the first 9 months of the year, the company generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, up 70% over the same period last year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter faced challenges including raw material inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions, and a ransomware attack.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter due to the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.
risks_headwinds.quote: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties in terms of LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics impaired availability to service demand by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations faced loss of business in the Gulf region due to geopolitical issues in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: And this, despite the loss of business in the Gulf region, we are, of course, hoping that there will be no further disruptions due to the geopolitical issues in the Middle East.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to accomplish an exhaustive portfolio makeover in the 125cc segment within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: The business aims to move exports beyond the 250,000 per month level starting from the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch 2 brand-new Pulsar models and 10 facelifts in the 160cc to 400cc range.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we will complete this exercise for the 150cc segment by the introduction of an absolutely new 150cc under the Pulsar brand and 10 facelifts in the 160cc to 400cc range with class-leading features and superior engine performance.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment during the year.
management_commitments.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

management_commitments.claim: Management will introduce new refreshes and a new range in both the 125cc and 150cc plus range in the Pulsar brand hitting the market in July.
management_commitments.quote: We'll have a new range in both the 125cc and the 150cc plus range. There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: The buyback payout is expected to happen sometime in the second week of July.
management_commitments.quote: Looking at the fresh timelines, I would expect that payouts would essentially happen sometime in the second week of July likely.

management_commitments.claim: Over 8 more interventions will be made in the Pulsar portfolio in the next 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

management_commitments.claim: The top management team exercise for KTM Austria will be completed by 1st April.
management_commitments.quote: The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
